lines.text: Is ethanol free gas really worth the extra money?
First he proves which gas has alcohol by mixing it with water which is a trick anyone can do at home.
Because ethanol loves water so it leaves the gas and sinks to the bottom with it.
And the regular gas turns out to be almost ten percent alcohol.
Then he looks inside a see through engine and the flame changes color with each fuel.
Ethanol carries oxygen inside its molecule so it burns differently but it also packs about a third less energy than gasoline.
beats: ai:a glowing 3D model of an ethanol molecule with a red oxygen atom floating in the dark
ai:two clear fuel drops side by side one glowing brighter with energy macro

lines.text: So he runs a fuel injected generator on each gas with the exact same load.
The ethanol free tank lasts 35 minutes while the E10 dies almost two minutes sooner.
That's about 4 percent more running time which matches the energy missing from the ethanol.
But the engine kept the same compression and almost the same carbon so it didn't hurt anything in this test.
So is ethanol free gas worth it for you?
